description: Free shows in Boston or Denver. Use this for “what’s free tonight?” or “free shows this weekend”. Returns only free listings (is_free / price 0). Default window is tonight (today + next 2 days). Pass window=weekend for Fri–Sun, window=upcoming for today onward. Paginated: default 20, max 50, always includes total. Default sort=evening. Do not call shows_tonight and filter client-side — tonight is ~174 shows.

city.description: boston (default: Boston, Cambridge, Somerville, Greater Boston) or denver (Denver, Boulder, the Colorado Front Range). Set denver for anything in Colorado.

event_type.description: comedy or music. Comedy is public event_type / finder ty=c, NOT a genre tag. Use for “comedy this week?”.

limit.description: Page size. Default 20, max 50. Do not request the full list — tonight is ~174 shows / ~36k tokens.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use with the returned total to page.

sort.description: evening (default): evening + upcoming first, not brunch-first chrono. time: raw chronological. popular: editorial picks first, then evening.

venue.description: Optional venue id, slug, or name substring.

via.description: Inbound UTM source written onto every Foobos deep link. Default muse.

window.description: tonight (default, today+2), weekend (Fri–Sun), or upcoming (today onward).

name: shows_free
title: Free shows
